newsitem.title: UK: Midlands pylon slightly hit by blast.
newsitem.headline: Midlands pylon slightly hit by blast.

text.p: The U.S.-owned Midlands Electricity plc said one of its pylons had been slighty damaged by a device whch exploded close to the M6 motorway in central England on Friday but that power supplies had not been affected.

"There is a damage to the pylon which is very close to the M6. We can't get to the site because the bomb squad is there. No electricity supplies have been cut off at the moment," a company spokeswoman said by telephone.

The device was one of two which exploded close to the M6. The blasts had all the hallmarks of the banned Irish Republican Army, which has mounted several attempts to disrupt Britain's May 1 election campaign.
Midlands Electricity Plc is owned by the U.S. Cinergy Corp and General Public Utilities. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
